data.one_liner: Flutter plugin to retrieve internal, external, and public storage directory paths on Android and iOS.
data.what_it_does: Provides async functions to get lists of external storage directories and specific public directories such as Downloads, Music, etc. Works on both Android and iOS, with iOS support added in v2.1.0.
use_when: You need to access device storage paths for file operations
You need to support multiple external storage locations (e.g., SD cards)
You require platform‑specific public directories like Downloads or Pictures
avoid_when: You only need basic file I/O and can use path_provider for simple paths
You are building a web or desktop app where storage paths are irrelevant
strengths: Supports a wide range of public directories on Android
Adds iOS SPM and UIScene lifecycle support
No extra permissions required for basic path retrieval
weaknesses: Does not provide file read/write utilities
No support for web or desktop platforms
data.setup_notes: Add dependency in pubspec.yaml, import package, call async methods; no special permissions needed.

alternatives.name: path_provider
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides similar directory retrieval but with fewer directory options and broader platform support (including web/desktop).
